title: Al-Layl 92:15-21 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y4 lesson 13 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-Layl 92:15-21 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 13. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: لَا يَصْلَىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلْأَشْقَى (١٥) ٱلَّذِى كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ (١٦) وَسَيُجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَتْقَى (١٧) ٱلَّذِى يُؤْتِى مَالَهُۥ يَتَزَكَّىٰ (١٨) وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعْمَةٍۢ تُجْزَىٰٓ (١٩) إِلَّا ٱبْتِغَآءَ وَجْهِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ (٢٠) وَلَسَوْفَ يَرْضَىٰ (٢١)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: None will [enter to] burn therein except the most wretched one.
Who had denied and turned away.
But the righteous one will avoid it -
[He] who gives [from] his wealth to purify himself
And not [giving] for anyone who has [done him] a favor to be rewarded
But only seeking the countenance of his Lord, Most High.
And he is going to be satisfied.

head: Word
Where
Rule
How to read it
rows: Full mouth; stretch the alif before hamza

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Layl 92:15-21 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 92:15-21 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 92:15-21 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Write one way you can give this week without wanting anything back.
questions.a: For example: help at home without being asked and not mention it.

questions.q: Recite all of Al-Layl (21 ayat) to a partner.
questions.a: All 21 ayat in order with no more than two prompts.

questions.q: Why does the giver in 92:19 to 20 give?
questions.a: A) Only seeking his Lord's pleasure. 92:19 to 20: not for anyone's favour to be repaid, but seeking the Face of his Lord. The other two are what he does not want.

questions.q: Al-Layl 92:20: «إِلَّا ٱبْتِغَآءَ ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: Why might someone give to others without wanting anything back, not even a thank you?
questions.a: They give only seeking the Face of their Lord, Most High, and Allah promises they will be pleased (92:19 to 21).
